items.title: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah's remarks on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical "Magnifica humanitas"
items.excerpt: Chris Olah reflects on the Pope's encyclical and its intersection with AI safety and the ethical responsibilities of AI researchers in building systems that benefit humanity.

items.title: Project Glasswing: An initial update
items.excerpt: Anthropic shares early results from Project Glasswing, a research initiative exploring interpretability methods that make AI model reasoning more transparent and auditable for safety purposes.

items.title: KPMG integrates Claude across its core business and workforce of more than 276,000
items.excerpt: KPMG has entered a strategic alliance with Anthropic to deploy Claude across its professional services, marking one of the largest enterprise AI deployments in the consulting industry.

items.title: Widening the conversation on frontier AI
items.excerpt: Anthropic calls for broader public engagement in discussions about frontier AI development, arguing that decisions about advanced AI systems should not be made by technologists alone.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.excerpt: Anthropic acquires Stainless, an SDK generation platform, to accelerate the development of developer tools and make it easier for engineers to build production applications on top of Claude.

items.title: PwC is deploying Claude to build technology and reinvent enterprise functions
items.excerpt: PwC's expanded partnership with Anthropic will see Claude deployed across deal execution, technology consulting, and enterprise transformation projects for PwC's global client base.

items.title: Designing for AI Trust: When Users Overcorrect
items.excerpt: Users who've been burned by AI errors often swing to excessive skepticism. Our research shows how calibrated confidence indicators and progressive disclosure can restore healthy AI reliance.

items.title: AI UX Patterns: 12 Emerging Interaction Models for 2026
items.excerpt: From ambient AI assistants to agentic task runners, we've catalogued 12 interaction patterns in production AI products, with guidelines on when each model serves users best.

items.title: Figma AI: Design from Prompt and Smarter Auto-Layout
items.excerpt: May's Figma AI updates bring natural-language screen composition, brand-voice-aware copy generation, and auto-layout suggestions that understand your design system's spacing conventions.

items.title: Config 2026: Design System AI and the Future of Component Libraries
items.excerpt: At Config 2026, Figma announced Design System AI — an intelligent layer that flags consistency deviations, auto-suggests component updates, and learns from your team's design patterns over time.

items.title: Linear 2026: AI Project Intelligence and Predictive Delivery
items.excerpt: Linear's new AI features automatically surface blockers, predict delivery dates with measurable accuracy, and generate sprint retrospectives grounded in actual velocity data.

items.title: Building with Notion AI: A Product Team's Playbook
items.excerpt: Four product teams share how they reshaped roadmapping, spec writing, and retrospectives with Notion AI — including honest assessments of where it accelerated work and where it fell short.

items.title: The Real Competitive Advantage of AI in Organizations
items.excerpt: Most companies are getting AI wrong. The winners aren't those with the most tools — they're those who redesign their decision-making processes around AI's actual strengths and failure modes.

items.title: Leading with AI: A Framework for Executive Decision-Making
items.excerpt: Three strategies separate AI-mature executives: reframing AI as organizational learning, building accountability systems for AI decisions, and designing for productive human-AI disagreement.

items.title: Rethinking Organizational Design for the AI Era
items.excerpt: AI doesn't just automate tasks — it reshapes collaboration, accountability, and knowledge flows. New research identifies which structural changes correlate with successful AI integration.

items.title: AI Strategy That Works: Moving Beyond the Hype Cycle
items.excerpt: Companies succeeding with AI share a counterintuitive trait: they invest more in organizational change than in technology. MIT research explains why change management is the real AI strategy.

items.title: The State of AI in 2026: McKinsey Global Survey
items.excerpt: McKinsey's annual survey of 1,400+ executives reveals AI adoption has plateaued at 65%, but value capture rates have tripled among leaders — creating a widening capability gap.

items.title: Designing the AI-Native Enterprise
items.excerpt: AI-native enterprises aren't built by adding AI to existing processes — they're designed from first principles with AI as a core capability, not an add-on layer.

items.title: BCG AI Radar: May 2026 — Agentic Systems and Governance Gaps
items.excerpt: May's AI Radar tracks the acceleration of agentic systems in enterprise workflows, the rising importance of AI governance functions, and early signals in autonomous AI-to-AI negotiation.

items.title: Human-AI Collaboration: What Two Years of Research Reveals
items.excerpt: BCG Henderson Institute's study of 200+ organizations finds the most effective human-AI teams are defined not by AI capabilities, but by how clearly roles and decision rights are allocated.

items.title: The State of AI Governance: 2026 Annual Report
items.excerpt: Stanford HAI's comprehensive analysis of global AI policy developments, regulatory frameworks, and the widening gap between technical capabilities and governance structures.

items.title: Measuring the ROI of Conversational AI Interfaces
items.excerpt: HAI research quantifies productivity gains from well-designed conversational AI, finding that trust and transparency design choices account for 40% of measurable efficiency gains.

items.title: Responsible AI Design Checklist for Product Teams
items.excerpt: A practical, printable checklist covering 28 responsibility criteria across fairness, transparency, human oversight, and reversibility — built for design reviews and sprint retrospectives.

items.title: Beyond Attention: DeepMind's New Hybrid Architecture
items.excerpt: DeepMind proposes a hybrid architecture combining attention mechanisms with structured state spaces, achieving 40% better efficiency on long-context tasks without quality degradation.
